# Third-party asset — 3D model of the Shroud of Turin

The 3D model in this directory and its decimated derivatives are **NOT** covered by
the repository's MIT license. They are used under the **Creative Commons Attribution
4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)** license.

- **Title:** *Data – 3D files – Shroud of Turin*
- **Source:** https://figshare.com/articles/dataset/Data_-_3D_files_-_Shroud_of_Turin/29645060
- **DOI:** 10.6084/m9.figshare.29645060

## Associated publication

Cícero Moraes, *"Image Formation on the Holy Shroud — A Digital 3D Approach,"*
Archaeometry (2026). DOI: 10.1111/arcm.70030

## Modifications (disclosed per CC BY 4.0 §3(a)(1)(B))

The files in `decimated/` are **modified** versions of the original mesh. The only
change is polygon reduction via quadric decimation to the face count named in each
filename (`body_3d_dec500.obj` ≈ 500 faces, `body_3d_dec1000.obj` ≈ 1000 faces, and
so on), produced for lightweight / real-time use. The geometry is otherwise
unaltered. These derivatives are shared under the same CC BY 4.0 license.

The original full-resolution model is available from the figshare source above.
